question: At what level should fire-pits of four hands and larger be constructed?
premises: Fire-pits may be four hands or larger
The same rule applies in all cases
The fire-pit should be level with the ground
inference: In all cases, including those beginning with four hands, the fire-pit should be level with the ground.
plain_english: Thus, even for fire-pits of four hands and so on, the fire-pit should everywhere be level with the ground.
